blocks.text: The Senate resumes the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte on Wednesday, September 16, as senators continue deliberations in the historic trial. Follow CDN Digital’s live coverage below for the latest developments, key exchanges, and updates from the Senate as the proceedings unfold. Davide: Impeachment vote base should only count qualified senators The two-thirds threshold in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial should be computed from senators legally and physically qualified to cast a vote, rather than automatically from the Senate’s full 24-member roster, retired chief justice Hilario Davide Jr. said Wednesday.
